what: The plan says upsert-diagrams-comment composes a body that already starts with the marker, then passes that composed file to tracking-issue-summary.sh, but tracking-issue-summary.sh always prepends the marker itself.
scenario_or_breakage: Every new larch:diagrams comment would contain a duplicate marker line, and tests for the exact published body will either encode the wrong contract or fail against the helper.
suggested_fix: Define the helper's delegated content file as sections-only when calling tracking-issue-summary.sh, or bypass tracking-issue-summary.sh for publication; keep dry-run responsible for printing the full marker-plus-sections preview if needed.

what: The deletion plan for compose-architecture-sketch removes Makefile references but omits the agent-lint dead-script exclusions and comments for the deleted harness files.
scenario_or_breakage: After the PR lands, agent-lint.toml will retain stale references to scripts/test-compose-architecture-sketch.sh and .md, making the reachability policy misleading and increasing future cleanup drift.
suggested_fix: Remove the compose-architecture-sketch entries and related comment text from agent-lint.toml, and broaden the final grep to include agent-lint.toml or run a repo-wide grep.

what: The plan changes diagram ownership and explicitly says diagrams are not a larch-log batch, but it does not update the shared Mermaid publication policy that still names a larch-log diagrams sanitizer and says this file must change when diagram publication behavior changes.
scenario_or_breakage: Consumers reading the shared policy after the PR may look for a nonexistent larch-log diagrams batch or preserve outdated enforcement assumptions while editing new diagram emitters.
suggested_fix: Update skills/shared/mermaid-safe-content.md to describe the new issue-scoped larch:diagrams helper, the remaining PR Code Flow embed, and the absence of a diagrams larch-log batch.
